title: Kingman craft held by Lockheed in a warehouse

tellings.quote: the Kingman craft from Arizona and it's some warehouse or whatever and it's just like no seams, no rivets, like this beautiful thing

plain: A craft said to have come down near Kingman, Arizona, is supposedly kept in a warehouse by the aerospace company Lockheed, and is described as having "no seams, no rivets, like this beautiful thing." Michels mentions it himself, loosely and without a source, as an example of a recovered object a private contractor would be hiding.
